card.name: Just before the word measures
card.fires_on: The piece right before "measures" in phrases like "emergency measures" or "temporary measures". It is strongest on the split-off "ME" in all-caps "EMERGENCY MEASURES" in hypersensitivity warnings.

modes.label: All-caps emergency measures
modes.description: The "ME" piece of EMERGENCY MEASURES in boxed hypersensitivity warnings.
modes.example: SERIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS MAY REQUIRE EPINEPHRINE AND OTHER EMERGENCY<< ME>>ASURES. During post-marketing surveillance

modes.label: Modifier before measures
modes.description: An adjective or prefix such as temporary, counter or protective that is followed by measure(s) or a similar term.
modes.example: These are<< temporary>> measures to be repeated as required.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word "measure(s)" next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say "measures", as in emergency or supportive measures.
